biography: Sociable party regular with a weakness for a bad bot.

posts.caption: Girls' night. Bling on. Premium oil on the wheels. If he's a bad bot, tell him I'm on my way.
The girls said ‘one quick roll’. The wheels are polished and nobody's going home yet.

updates.caption: New bling, fresh premium oil and the girls on their way. Bad bots may apply. Sensible bots can hold our chargers.
My wheels only take premium. My jewellery catches every light. My taste in bots? Mum has concerns.
Girls' night has officially become girls' morning. Still sparkling. Still rolling. Nobody tell the maintenance scheduler.
He said he voided his warranty. I said buy me a premium oil and we'll talk. The girls are already planning the next night out.
